title: GPU capacity intake manifest
body:
Tab: Intake Log
Columns: Request ID | Team | Requestor | Priority | GPUs requested | GPU type | Region(s) | Start date | End date | Duration (weeks) | Primary use case | Perf target / notes | Dependencies | Cost est (USD/mo) | Triage score | Approval status | Approver | Approval date | Notes | Linked tickets

Row examples:
CR-2026-001 | Research-LLM | Priya Singh | High | 32 | A100-80GB | us-west1, europe-west1 | 2025-02-03 | 2025-08-03 | 26 | Model pretraining (prototype) | Target 200 tokens/s aggregate; needs NVLINK | Data staging S3 + infra PR-1893 | 48,000 | 8.2 | approved | Liam Chen | 2025-01-20 | Canary run to validate batch sizes; prefer dedicated pool | JIRA:ML-221, PR:ml-data-44
CR-2026-004 | Product-Rerank | Diego Morales | Medium | 8 | A100-40GB | us-central1 | 2025-05-01 | 2025-11-01 | 26 | Online reranking (low-latency) | 95th perc latency < 60ms; requires batching and prefix cache | Depends on routing policy update INFRA-412 | 9,600 | 6.1 | pending | — | — | Waiting on priority confirmation from PM | JIRA:PR-778
CR-2026-007 | Ads-Platform | Marisol Rivera | Critical | 64 | H100-80GB | asia-southeast1, us-west1 | 2025-03-15 | 2025-09-15 | 26 | Real-time scoring at scale | Sustained throughput 3k req/s, use model quantized int8 | Must coordinate cross-region DR | 96,000 | 9.5 | approved | Asha Patel | 2025-02-28 | Reserve burst nodes for launch week | JIRA:ADS-2026
CR-2026-009 | Internal-Experiments | Owen Park | Low | 4 | V100-32GB | us-west1 | 2025-06-01 | 2025-07-01 | 4 | Small experiments and debug | Noncritical; can use preemptible | None | 600 | 3.0 | in_review | Marisol Rivera | 2025-05-20 | Consider rolling into shared dev pool | JIRA:EXP-90
CR-2026-012 | Dedicated-Partners | Hana Kim | High | 16 | A100-80GB | europe-west1 | 2025-04-01 | 2026-04-01 | 52 | Partner-dedicated capacity (SLA) | SLA 99.95% monthly uptime; isolated tenancy required | Contract and billing approval required | 24,000 | 8.8 | approved | Devon O'Neil | 2025-03-10 | Set up private VPC and KMS | CONTRACT:PART-44
CR-2026-015 | Research-Quant | Anika Bose | Medium | 12 | A10G | us-central1 | 2025-07-15 | 2025-10-15 | 13 | Quantization experiments | Lower memory footprint; test 4-bit flows | Needs model conversion tooling | 3,900 | 5.7 | pending | — | — | Requestor asked to provide eval prompts | GITHUB:quant-exps-12

Triage rubric (used to compute 'Triage score'):
- Normalization: GPUs requested normalized across current intake window (cap capped at 256 for scoring).
- Priority mapping: Critical=10, High=7, Medium=4, Low=1.
- Urgency: Start within 4 weeks = 10, 4-12 weeks = 6, >12 weeks = 2.
- Business impact: revenue or regulatory critical = 10, strategic = 7, internal / exploratory = 3.
- Score formula (displayed in sheet): score = round((norm_gpus * 0.25) + (priority_score * 0.4) + (urgency_score * 0.2) + (impact_score * 0.15), 1)
- Example (CR-2026-007): norm_gpus=0.85 (64/75 cap baseline), priority_score=10 (Critical), urgency_score=8, impact_score=10 => score ~ 9.5

Intake process (short):
1) Request submitted via form (link in linked_artifacts) -> creates CR id and populates sheet.
2) Triage (eng-infrastructure) runs scoring within 2 business days.
3) Cost estimate and region feasibility reviewed by infra infra-ops -> add estimate.
4) Approvals: for >32 GPUs require infra lead + SRE sign-off + finance if cost > $50k/mo. For dedicated/private longer-term (>6 months) include legal/contract.
5) Scheduling: planner assigns to next capacity window and reserves nodes; requestor is notified with tentative start date.

Approval SLA and owner responsibilities:
- Triage turnaround: 2 business days.
- Approval for <=32 GPUs: 5 business days.
- Approval for >32 GPUs: 10 business days (includes finance).
- Scheduling confirmation: 7 business days after approval to provide start date and pool assignment.
- Owners: infra intake = Asha Patel (owner), infra scheduling = Liam Chen, cost review = Devon O'Neil.

Capacity guidance and equivalences (notes):
- Typical equivalences used for rough costing: 1 A100-80GB ~ 2x A100-40GB, 1 H100 ~ 1.8x A100-80GB for throughput in our benchmarks (varies by model).
- For shared pools prefer A100-40/80 mixes. H100 reserved for latency-sensitive or float16 workloads.
- Preemptible/spot usage allowed for low-priority requests; mark 'preemptible' in notes column.

Costing quick reference (monthly rough):
- A100-80GB (dedicated reserved): $1,500 / card/mo (committed discount may apply).
- A100-40GB: $900 / card/mo.
- H100-80GB: $2,200 / card/mo.
- V100-32GB: $150 / card/mo (spot).

Operational notes and follow-ups:
- When region capacity is tight: route to alternate region or propose quantized/condensed model variants.
- For multi-region requests, indicate primary region; cross-region fallbacks require network/team coordination.
- If approval is pending > SLA, escalate to infra director with email template prefilled (see linked_artifacts).

How to use this sheet: add new row with requested info, attach linked tickets in 'Linked tickets', and tag "requires-finance" if monthly cost > $50k. After approval, change 'Approval status' to approved and fill approver and date. Use triage score to sort weekly planning meeting agenda.

Change log (sheet-level):
- 2024-11-05: initial template created by Asha Patel.
- 2025-01-20: added triage rubric and automated score column.
- 2025-03-10: added dedicated partner flow and contract column note.
- 2025-07-02: clarified approval SLA for >32 GPUs.
- 2026-03-01: updated cost reference rates; added H100 examples (editor: Asha Patel).

Contact: Asha Patel (asha.patel@redwood.ai) for intake questions; use Slack #infra-capacity for day-to-day coordination.
